uplink.description: battery 3.5 V, analog input 1 = 3.0 V, external digital input high
uplink._note: ELSYS TLV: VDD(0x07)=0x0DAC=3500 mV -> battery 3.5 V; ANALOG1(0x08)=0x0BB8=3000 mV -> analog.voltage 3.0 V; EXT_DIGITAL(0x0D)=1 -> contactState closed. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (vdd 3500, analog1 3000, digital 1).

uplink.description: external temperature-equivalent temp + relative and absolute pulse counts
uplink._note: TEMP(0x01)=0x00C8=200/10=20 degC -> air.temperature; PULSE1(0x0A)=100 -> pulse.count; PULSE1_ABS(0x0B)=0x000003E8=1000 -> pulse.total. Verified against reference/upstream-codec.js (temperature 20, pulse1 100, pulseAbs 1000).

uplink.description: payload stopping at an unsupported ELSYS type still decodes leading fields
uplink._note: ANALOG1(0x08)=0x07D0=2000 mV -> 2.0 V, then ACC(0x03) is unsupported and stops the walk (upstream default: skip to end). A warning is emitted.
